453135.overview: Fire up the Blackbird and get ready for another battle. The X-Men never have it easy!

456301.overview:
X-Men Mutant Apocalypse Remake is a fangame that was originally part of Marvel Infinity War since 2014, and is now being released as a separate game, thus being able to be more faithful to the original game, from the screen resolution to the position of the health bars.

The game has 20 playable X-Men and 10 more characters unlocked after the game was finished. The combo system is dynamic and the gameplay is much faster than the original, with running, defense, dodging and several special moves. Although the main basis of the game is X-Men Mutant Apocalypse, it is possible to recognize moves from different games adapted here, such as X-Men 2 Clone Wars, Wolverine Adamantium Rage, the VS series of fighting games for Arcade and even X-Men Reign of Apocalypse for Game Boy Advance. This remake does not aim to be identical to the original. The stages are shortened vertically to avoid camera problems when playing with 4 players. Many bosses, such as the Helicopter from the Gambit stage, are impossible to do here. All characters would need to have a move that shoots upwards.

457753.overview:
Another remake of our beloved superhero games from the last century has been released!

The original game was one of the most beautiful at the time, despite being very unfair like most of its contemporaries.
In this remake, the base of the SNES games for most of the characters is maintained, but adapted to have the uniform of the Konami game. Based on the original, there is have Colossus and Dazzler. Wolverine and Cyclops are from X-Men Mutant Apocalypse for the SNES, Nightcrawler is from X-Men 2 Clone Wars for the SEGA Genesis and Storm is from X-Men: Reign of Apocalypse for the Game Boy Advance, thus creating that mix but trying to keep them all in the same standard style. 

Here we have a new feature that is implemented for the first time in the projects, CPU partners, although the game allows 4 players to play, it is difficult to gather 4 friends around a computer and many are unable to configure a tool like Parsec to play online. This mode still needs adjustments and should be improved in the future.

458296.overview:
ABOUT THE PROJECT: 
  This game is based on the Konami Arcade version created by Zvitor for OpenBOR v4.0. This special edition is completed and is exclusive to Sega DreamCast using DreamBOR engine.

DETAILS: 

Version 2.01 (Final Version)[2025-09-30]:
 * Now contains 3 game modes; The Arcade Mode, The Remake Mode and The Battle Mode
 * Added Mr. Sinistro as a selectable character) only in modes; Remake and Battle
 * Added new improved music for Remake mode
 * Added new high-quality custom cinematics using v2.00 (official) replacing the beta version
 * Added intro templates to levels
 * Added small differences in game levels between Arcade mode and Remake
 * Added custom staff (similar to the arcade version)
 * Fixed stage 6 slow-down
 * Re-encoded the game scripts, fixing the malfunctions in the DreamBOR v7.1r/v7.2r engine
 * Re-located the game files, now the data loading is faster
 * Removed 96% of WOKE content ;-) from the previous version
 * Unified teams (X-Men, X-Force, eXiles) in a single mode called Remake (also included in battle mode)

Version 2.02 (Fixed Version)[2025-11-15];
 * Added 7 selectable characters (5 variants and 2 guests) in Remake and Battle Boss modes only
 * Added an additional boss in Battle Mode
 * Optimized and reduced [Weight x Quality] the soundtracks (Original / Arrange) and cinemas of the game
 * Re-set the level selector in Arcade and Remake modes
 * Re-designed the color ballot for sprites, levels, characters and backgrounds
 * Reduced the size (weight) of the game
 * Re-corrected common bugs from the previous version
 * Removed DreamBOR engines v7.2rr and v7.1rr for DreamBOR engines v7.1rrr, now with secure save and no script errors
